definition: Having or showing keen mental discernment
Having a ready insight into and understanding of things
example: A perspicacious analysis of the situation
His sardonic wit was both amusing and cutting
Her mordant commentary on politics was spot-on

definition: The ability to make good judgments and quick decisions
example: His business acumen led to great success

definition: Having or showing great knowledge or learning
example: An erudite scholar with vast knowledge

definition: Treating serious issues with deliberately inappropriate humor
example: His facetious remarks lightened the mood

definition: Filled with bitter criticism or malice
example: His vitriolic attack on the proposal was harsh

definition: Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations
example: An astute observation about market trends

definition: Overly concerned with minor details or rules
example: His pedantic approach to grammar was tiresome
